what: ports whose behaviour DISAGREES with the shipped bytes, held out pending a reading of the disassembly
why: a disagreement is evidence about one of three things and it takes the shipped instructions to say which: the reconstruction, this repo's port of it, or the harness. job_input_goods went this way and turned out to be the reconstruction. None of these are in src/: an unresolved disagreement is not a port.

disputed.goods_row_add: the writes are indexed by the global g_row_count, which the sweep cannot control; at the shipped value they wrap inside segment 26 (26:fffe) and run off the array on a host. Needs the emulator-side differential or a staged counter.
disputed.MapWin_TileSize: returns 0x4944 where the shipped returns 0x944: one bit, which reads like a member taken at the wrong width.
disputed.tile_neighbor_mask: the shipped function does not reach its return in the emulator, in either the shipped or the save state, while the port does. All of this family reads through the pointer global g_map_tiles2. Whether the shipped code needs a register or a fixture this harness does not set, or the reconstruction is wrong, takes a reading of the instructions to say.
